text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Cabinet meeting chaired by President Ben Ali approved a draft law allowing private interests to run maritime ports.
- President Ben Ali received a report from Culture Minister Abdelbaki Hermassi on preparations of summer festivals.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui and visiting South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki signed air transports accord. Mbeki started on Wednesday a three-day official visit to Tunis.
- Tunisia to set up a diplomatic training institute.
- A cabinet meeting recommends a national strategy against nicotine addiction.
